clips.title: The story
paras: At the Tower of Althalaxx, Dark Strand cultists are gathering, and Balthule Shadowstrike needs help. He sends an Alliance courier to Maestra's Post in Ashenvale with a warning for his mentor, Delgren the Purifier.

Balthule Shadowstrike sees that the Dark Strand threat is too great for one scout to face alone. After clashing with cultists near the Tower of Althalaxx, he writes a report and entrusts it to an Alliance messenger bound for his master, Delgren the Purifier. The cult's summoners are growing bolder, and Balthule needs seasoned leaders to direct a response.

Balthule's dispatch takes you south along Darkshore's coastal road, then across the wooded border into Ashenvale. Delgren the Purifier is stationed at Maestra's Post, beside the western road. The human paladin works to cleanse demons and undead from the woodland. Though night elven customs were once unfamiliar to him, he has earned the Sentinels' deep respect as an indispensable ally.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My master, Delgren the Purifier, is a paladin who has graciously offered his assistance in defending our forests from the forces of the demons and undead. He has taught me much about the Holy Light and the art of battle.
Delgren must know of the cult's operations immediately.
You will find him far south of here at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale Forest. Be swift, I fear the Dark Strand's threat grows with each passing hour.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You have some business with me, adventurer?

clips.title: Completion
paras: If you don't mind my saying, you seem a bit well-equipped for a messenger, hm? I suppose Balthule wanted to be certain that his letter reached my hands. Let's see what he has to say...
This is disturbing news. When undead or demonic forces are found, I help the Sentinels destroy them.
At first I was unaccustomed to the manners of the night elves, but I have grown to respect them greatly as allies.
